title: The Pullman estate no longer claims to match its photographs
items: The Pullman house, palm house, stable and 18th Street glasshouses are marked as not yet matching their photographs. They don't, and their rework has started.
The built-so-far walk no longer lists the 18th Street glasshouses among the buildings that match their pictures.
A building whose work was split into smaller jobs can no longer finish without matching its pictures.
